text:
Absolutely — here’s a simple Mediterranean-style grocery list for the week, built for you and your partner, with no numbers:

- fresh veg: tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers, onions, greens, zucchini, carrots
- fruit: lemons, berries, apples, oranges, grapes
- proteins: chickpeas, lentils, eggs, yogurt, feta, fish, chicken, tofu if you like it
- grains: bread, rice, couscous, pasta, oats
- pantry: olive oil, garlic, olives, tahini, canned tomatoes, herbs, capers, vinegar
- extras: hummus, nuts, seeds, avocados

If you want, I can turn this into a full meal plan for the week or sort it into a cleaner shopping list by store aisle.
